info.name: FinOps Enterprise — Assignment 2 Complete API Acceptance Suite
info.description: Ordered, stateful Postman tests generated. Run folders 00 through 04 in order with Collection Runner on an isolated TEST/DEVELOPMENT database. This suite creates 3 clients, 3 accounts, 1 completed transfer, and 1 rejected transfer and changes financial balances. NEVER run against important data. Folder 05 has optional fixture-dependent requests. Folder 06 requires a MANUAL container restart between separately selected Before and After requests. This collection does NOT automate Docker build/start, replica-set election, migration, failure-injection TX-14, concurrent processing TX-13, database restart, browser Not Found AT-19, or storage outage AT-20. Use backend Node tests and Docker commands for those scenarios. The original Assignment 1 twenty tests are only partly covered by Postman; browser and restart tests require separate verification.

item.name: 00 - Setup and health
item.description: Run this folder FIRST. Creates fresh unique test values and records the dashboard baseline. Use a test or development deployment only.

item.name: 00.01 Initialize run and check API health
01 - Corporate clients (Assignment 1 regression)
item.description: Creates three fictional clients and verifies registration, duplicates, validation, immutable fields, updates, filters, and dashboard change.

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Valid client UUID and active status',function(){pm.expect(b.clientId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i);pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('Active');pm.expect(b.registrationNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('reg'));});

item.name: AT-04 Reject duplicate registration ignoring case

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Updated company, unchanged identity',function(){pm.expect(b.companyName).to.eql('Postman Financial Updated Ltd');pm.expect(b.clientId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('testClientId'));pm.expect(b.registrationNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('reg'));});
const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Exactly one client created so far',function(){pm.expect(b.totalClients).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('initialClientCount'))+1);});

item.name: 02 - Financial accounts (Assignment 1 regression)
item.description: Three Active financial accounts across two clients plus negative business validation and filtering tests.

item.name: Create USD account for mismatch test
AT-08 Reject account for nonexistent client
AT-09 Reject account for Suspended client

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('All accounts match client and currency',function(){pm.expect(b).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;b.forEach(a=>{pm.expect(a.clientId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('testClientId'));pm.expect(a.currency).to.eql('CAD');});});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Both destination and USD accounts belong to client',function(){pm.expect(b.map(x=>x.accountId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('destinationId'));pm.expect(b.map(x=>x.accountId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('usdId'));});

item.name: AT-10 Verify no extra account was created

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Only source account belongs to primary test client',function(){pm.expect(b.filter(a=>a.clientId===pm.collectionVariables.get('testClientId'))).to.have.lengthOf(1);});

04 - Transaction processing and financial invariants
item.description: Successful debit/credit, duplicate prevention, insufficient funds, processing errors and dashboard aggregate assertions.

item.name: TX-08 Verify source debit exactly once
TX-08 Verify destination credit exactly once
TX-12 Completed transfer cannot run again

exec: const b=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('No new transaction and retained Completed',function(){pm.expect(b.transactionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('transferId'));pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('Completed');});

item.name: TX-09 Process and reject insufficient funds
TX-16 Dashboard counts and CAD volume
TX-06 No duplicate transaction by key

request.description: Additional weak list-level check; the exact duplicate invariant is covered by the idempotent retry and database unique key. This page may not contain the transfer in a large database.

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Transfer appears once in available first page',function(){pm.expect(b.data.filter(t=>t.transactionId===pm.collectionVariables.get('transferId')).length).to.be.at.most(1);});

item.name: 05 - Optional seeded-state tests
item.description: Optional: historical Pending legacy transaction, Frozen source and Closed destination. Requests skip where optional IDs are not supplied; the first legacy search fails visibly if no fixture is present.

exec: const b=pm.response.json();const legacy=b.data.find(t=>t.isLegacy===true&&t.status==='Pending');if(legacy)pm.collectionVariables.set('legacyPendingId',legacy.transactionId);pm.test('Legacy Pending fixture found',function(){pm.expect(legacy,'Provide a legacy Pending fixture if none is present').to.exist;});

request.description: Optional. Set frozenAccountId to an existing CAD Frozen account. Source and destination must differ.
Optional. Set closedAccountId to an existing CAD Closed account.

item.name: 06 - Manual TX-15 / DO-06 restart evidence
item.description: Do NOT Run All on this folder. Set manualPersistence=true. Run the three Before requests individually, execute docker compose down && docker compose up -d (never -v), and then run the three After requests individually. Same captured collection variables are required.
